Your Mane Master™ is lovingly made with natural wood, painted details, and premium bristles — so it deserves a little TLC to keep it looking (and working) its best. Here’s how to keep it clean and happy:

1. After each use, gently remove any trapped hair with your fingers or a wide-tooth comb to prevent build-up.

2. Mix a small amount of gentle shampoo or mild soap with lukewarm water — but avoid soaking the whole brush, as water and wood don’t mix well!

3. Dip a clean toothbrush or soft cloth into the soapy water and softly scrub the bristles and base. Be careful not to saturate the wooden handle or painted areas.

4. Wipe the brush with a clean, damp cloth to remove any soap residue. Then, dry the bristles with a towel and lay the brush bristle-side down to air dry completely.

Important: Never submerge your Mane Master™ in water — this can damage the wood and paint over time.

Top Tip: Give your Mane Master™ a gentle clean every 1–2 weeks for the smoothest, healthiest hair experience!
